findings.description: Sword blade clips directly through solid steel chest plate armor without deformation.
findings.fix: Adjust collision geometry to target armor seams or add impact deformation.
findings.refined_description: The sword blade penetrates straight through the solid steel breastplate armor without any metal deformation, deflecting, or realistic physical resistance, clipping directly into the chest.

summary: The battle scene maintains strong action framing and atmospheric depth. Realism is hindered by clipping artifacts where weapons easily penetrate solid metal plate. Refining weapon collision physics is recommended to elevate overall quality.
